pie: kʷíd h₁súmenes h₂éwsōs h₁rudʰéh₁ti? h₁yód h₂éwsōs h₁rudʰéh₁eti h₂wérseti. méh₂tēr moy méǵʰye ḱód sékʷt. snéygʷʰēti? ne snéygʷʰēti sríHgos lelóykʷe.
english: Kindly, why is the dawn red? When the dawn is red, it will rain. My mother told me this. Will it snow? It will not snow: the cold is gone.

pie: bʰréh₂ter trémsi. snígʷʰm̥ dedwóyth₂e? tā́m ne dedwóyh₂e. sríHǵesh₁ me h₁épt. nu péh₂wr̥ gʷm̥dʰí. gʷm̥sḱóh₂. ph₂tréy-kʷe nos mē wéwkes.
english: You are trembling, brother! Are you afraid of the snow? I am not afraid of it. The cold has seized me. Then come to the fire! I am coming. And do not tell our father!

pie: dʰúgh₂ter bʰréh₁wr̥ gʷh₂dʰí wódr̥-kʷe bʰére. h₁íd ḱolHtóm. ḱolHtóm wódr̥ gʷʰéresi h₁wésu. nu polh₁ú bʰérōh₂.
english: Daughter, go to the well and carry water! It is cold. Cold water is good in the heat. Then I shall carry much.

pie: kʷóm ph₂teres h₂éǵrons h₂érh₃yōmes? h₁yód dʰéǵʰōm gʷʰéreti h₂érh₃yōmes. nu h₁íh₂ ḱolHtéh₂? h₁íh₂ ḱolHtéh₂. sríHgos nékʷti h₁ésyeh₂i h₁épi ḱéyor. nu uksénn̥s yéwgomes.
english: Father, when shall we plough the fields? When the earth grows warm, we shall plough. Is it cold now? It is cold. At night frost lies on it. Then we shall yoke the bulls.

pie: ḱóymom neh₂wéh₁ gʷéh₂omes? ǵʰiméni ne gʷéh₂omes. wódr̥ stéwdt. h₁íd wésni gʷʰermóm h₁éseti. h₁éḱwōs nos ne wéǵʰōnti? tóy nos wéǵʰōnti h₁yód snóygʷʰos leléykʷeti.
english: Shall we go to the village by boat? We shall not go in winter. The water has become cold. In spring it will be warm. Will the horses not carry us? They will carry us when the snow is gone.

pie: kúdʰe h₁súmenes ǵʰh₂énses ǵʰiméni h₁ités? h₂epó sóh₂wl̥ próti h₁yénti. h₂én gʷʰréh₁yeti. h₂ew h₁ludʰṓnti? wésni h₁ludʰṓnti ǵʰh₂énsn̥s-kʷe ḱléwesi.
english: Kindly, where do the geese go in winter? They go away towards the sun. There it is warm. Will they arrive again? They will arrive in spring, and you will hear the geese.

pie: méh₂ter léwkt? ne léwkt. h₂éwsōs ne gʷegʷóme. l̥gʰdʰí. stéwdm̥-ge. súHnew h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂h₁ stégeso.
english: Mother, has it grown light? It has not grown light. Dawn has not come. Lie down! I have indeed grown cold. Cover yourself with the wool, son!

pie: príHe moy bʰréh₂tr̥s ḱóymom gʷéh₂oh₂? gʰóstey mē gʷéh₂s. pl̥h₁éwih₂ snígʷʰs dʰǵʰémi ḱéyor wĺ̥kʷōs-kʷe h₂isḱónti. kʷóm yéh₂oh₂? h₁yód snóygʷʰos tinéh₁eti ih₂dʰí. nu moy ph₂wéni sédye.
english: Friend, shall I go to my brother's village? Do not go, guest! Much snow lies on the earth, and the wolves are searching. When shall I go? Go when the snow has melted. Now sit at my fire.

pie: snóygʷʰos tinéh₁t yéh₂oh₂-kʷe. gʰóstey kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. deywṓs te h₂léksoyh₁ent. h₁uséwōm moy déh₃tor túH priHós. gʷʰéresi h₂ew gʷm̥dʰí.
english: The snow has melted, and I shall go. Be well, guest! May the gods protect you! You are dear to me, giver of good things. Come again in the warm weather!

pie: kʷíd sríHgos? dʰéǵʰōm nékʷti stéwdt sríHgos-kʷe dʰéyǵʰesh₂ h₂usési stégeti. sríHgos tinéh₁ti? tinéh₁ti h₁yód sóh₂wl̥ léwketi.
english: What is frost? At night the earth becomes cold, and at dawn frost covers the walls. Does the frost melt? It melts when the sun becomes bright.

pie: ph₂ter moy wr̥h₁dʰí kʷíd h₂ŕ̥tḱos ǵʰiméni dʰédʰeh₁ti? h₂ŕ̥tḱos ǵʰiméni swóy légʰesi ḱéyor ne-kʷe h₁ḗdti. h₁yód wósr̥ gʷémeti bʰéwdʰt kénketi-kʷe. h₂ówins h₁ḗdti? tā́s h₁ḗdti h₁yód poh₂imḗn tā́s ne péh₂seti.
english: Father, tell me: what does the bear do in winter? In winter the bear lies in his lair and does not eat. When spring comes, he wakes up, and he is hungry. Does he eat sheep? He eats them, if the shepherd does not guard them.

pie: ḱós uksḗn wetséh₂i? só wetsós péruti ǵn̥h₁yéto. h₁yód h₂wékseti kʷékʷlom déwketi. nu tóm h₂éǵōh₂? súHnew tóm h₂éǵēsi h₁eǵóh₂-kʷe spéḱyōh₂.
english: Is this bull a year old? He is a year old: he was born last year. When he has grown up, he will draw the wagon. Shall I drive him then? You will drive him, son, and I shall look on.

pie: kʷóm swésor wósr̥ gʷm̥sḱéti? h₁yód sóh₂wl̥ gʷʰéreti wósr̥ gʷm̥sḱéti. nu kʷíd gʷm̥yéti? nu gʷm̥yéti gʷʰéros ǵénh₁mn̥h₂-kʷe h₂wékst. yóh₁r̥ wértetor ǵʰéymn̥-kʷe h₁idʰé h₁ésti.
english: Sister, when does spring come? When the sun grows warm, spring comes. And what comes then? Then comes the heat, and the offspring grow up. The year turns, and winter is here.

pie: h₁n̥dóm kʷis h₁ésti? h₁eǵóh₂ gʰóstis h₁regʷesyéti-kʷe. kʷís túH? kʷíd toy h₁nómn̥? h₁eǵóh₂ h₁suḱléwēs. wĺ̥kʷōs me snígʷʰm̥ pér sékʷonto. h₁súḱlewes wiḱdʰí n̥sméy-kʷe priHós h₁sdʰí.
english: Is anyone inside? I am a stranger, and it is getting dark. Who are you? What is your name? I am Of-Good-Fame. The wolves followed me through the snow. Enter, Of-Good-Fame, and be dear to us!

pie: bʰréh₂ter memónth₂e? péruti snéygʷʰet sríHgos-kʷe nos h₂ówins moréyet. memónh₂e. ḱód ǵʰéymn̥ n̥sméy h₁wésu h₁syéh₁t. deywṓs nos gʷʰéros dh₃ih₁ént. sríHgos-kʷe nos uksénn̥s mē moréyoyh₁t.
english: Brother, do you remember? Last year it snowed, and the cold killed our sheep. I remember. May this winter be good to us! May the gods give us warm weather! And may the cold not kill our bulls!

pie: swésor ḱā́m h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m h₁áyso. ǵʰéymn̥ gʷm̥yéti. túH moy ḱéyweh₂. h₂énkuleh₂m toy déh₃oh₂. ḱóymos toy gʷʰermós? h₁éy gʷʰermós. wiHrós moy ph₂wéni sédyeti.
english: Sister, take this wool. Winter is coming. You are dear to me. I shall give you a belt. Is your home warm? It is warm. My husband is sitting by the fire.

pie: "tód h₁estu", wéwked lewkós deywós wérunos.
english: "Let this be so," said the bright god Werunos.

pie: mluHdʰí moy kʷíd wĺ̥kʷos ḱóymom ǵʰiméni gʷm̥sḱéti? kénketi. ǵʰwḗres snígʷʰi ḱélontor. kʷíd h₂isḱéti? ǵʰh₂énsn̥s nos h₂isḱéti ḱwónes-kʷe wĺ̥kʷom h₂epó h₂éǵonti.
english: Tell me: why does the wolf come to the village in winter? He is hungry. The wild animals hide in the snow. What does he seek? He seeks our geese, and the dogs drive the wolf away.

pie: príHe toy dʰǵʰyés h₂wérst? h₂wérst bʰréh₁wōr-kʷe pl̥nh₁tó. dʰéǵʰōm polh₁ú péh₃t. h₂éǵroysu moy ne h₂wérst. h₂wérseti. h₂éwsōs h₁rudʰéh₁t.
english: Friend, did it rain on you yesterday? It rained, and the wells filled up. The earth drank much. On my fields it did not rain. It will rain. The dawn was red.

pie: kúdʰe póh₂imen gʷówes ǵʰiméni sth₂éh₁yonti? ǵʰiméni h₁n̥dóm sth₂éh₁yonti snóygʷʰos-kʷe h₂éǵrons stégeti. kʷís tóns nékʷti h₂lékseti? ḱwónes tóns h₂léksonti h₁eǵóh₂-kʷe bʰéwdʰoh₂.
english: Shepherd, where do the cattle stand in winter? In winter they stand inside, and the snow covers the pastures. Who protects them at night? The dogs protect them, and I stay awake.

pie: swésor moy wósr̥ gʷr̥nHdʰí. wósr̥ dʰéǵʰōm gʷegʷóme. snóygʷʰos bʰéwgt. uksénes h₁éǵʰs h₁yénti ǵʰh₂énses-kʷe gʷm̥yónti. h₂ew gʷéHye. ḱóm gʷéHyōmes.
english: Sister, praise the spring for me! Spring has come to the earth! The snow has fled. The bulls go out, and the geese come. Sing again! Let us sing together!

pie: tod ḱeḱruwos owis aǵrom ebʰuget.
english: Having heard this, the sheep fled into the plain.

pie: kúdʰe h₂nér kʷékʷloh₁ h₁éysi? bʰréh₂tr̥s moy ḱóymom h₁éymi. suHnús tósmey ǵeǵónh₁e. deywṓs toy h₁wésuh₂ dh₃ih₁ént. snóygʷʰos lelóykʷe h₁éḱwōs-kʷe moy HeHḱéwes.
english: Where are you going with the wagon, man? I am going to my brother's home. A son has been born to him. May the gods give you good things! The snow is gone, and my horses are swift.

pie: bʰréh₂ter snéygʷʰeti. h₁éǵʰs yéh₂ete. ph₂tḗr nos wéwket. sríHǵesi h₁éǵʰs mē ih₂té. só poh₂iménn̥s léytt. nu h₁éǵʰs yéh₂omes moḱs-kʷe h₂ew gʷémomes.
english: Brother, it is snowing! Let us go out! Our father said: Do not go out into the cold! He has gone away to the shepherds. Then let us go out, and let us come back quickly!

pie: bʰréh₂ter h₂ew gʷegʷómth₂e. skʷdʰí moy kúdʰe ǵʰiméni h₁és? h₃rēǵés poh₂imn̥bʰís ḱóm h₁ésm̥. polh₁ús snóygʷʰos h₂én ḱéyo ne-kʷe gʷā́m. h₃rḗǵs toy misdʰóm déh₃t? h₁éḱwom moy déh₃t.
english: Brother, you have come back! Tell me: where were you in winter? I was with the shepherds of the king. Much snow lay there, and I did not go. Did the king give you a reward? He gave me a horse.

pie: méh₂ter gʰóstis snígʷʰm̥ pér gʷm̥sḱéti. kʷíh₁ tósmey bʰéh₂oh₂? tósmey wr̥h₁dʰí. gʰóstey kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. péh₂wr̥ gʷm̥dʰí. kʷíd-kʷe tósmey déh₃oh₂? tósmey gʷʰr̥nóm dh₃dʰí.
english: Mother, a guest is coming through the snow. How shall I speak to him? Say to him: Be well, guest! Come to the fire! And what shall I give him? Give him something warm.

pie: ph₂ter sh₂wéni sddʰí. gʷʰért. dʰúgh₂ter me sóh₂wl̥ gʷʰr̥néwti. ǵʰiméni sríHǵesi trḗm. nu gʷṓs h₂mélǵsi? tóns moḱs h₂mélǵmi.
english: Father, sit in the sun! It has grown warm. The sun warms me, daughter. In winter I trembled in the cold. Are you milking the cows now? I milk them early.

pie: owis eḱwoi kʷe
english: The Sheep and the Horses
